The '''Council of Nine''' is one of the governing bodies of [[Illian]]. It shares governing power with the King and the [[Assemblage]].

The Council of Nine meets in the [[Great Hall of the Council]]. It is situated across from the King's Palace in the Square of Tammaz. The palace is identical to the King's Palace, even down to the lamps, but slightly smaller in every dimension. Each member of the council wears a green sash, even over armor.{{ref/book|8|13}}

*[[Argirin Darelos den Turamon]]
*[[Ballin Elamri den Rendalle]]

*[[Gregorin Panar den Lushenos]]
*[[Jeordwyn Semaris den Tropan]]
*[[Kiril Drapaneos den Alangar]]
*[[Marac Pandelaros den Norvin]]
*[[Spiron Narettin den Sovar]]

Sammael either replaced a gap in the Council of Nine or created a gap by murdering an existing member. "Lord Brend" was replaced by Marac Pandelaros den Norvin. The other eight known members presumably have not changed in recent years.
